title: Prediction & Retrieval Strategies
summary: This module provides core strategies for generating predictions and retrieving relevant information within DSPy programs. It encompasses advanced prediction techniques, agentic behaviors, and various retrieval mechanisms to build robust and intelligent language model applications.

nodes.label: Advanced Prediction Strategies
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction Strategies
nodes.description: Provides a collection of advanced prediction strategies and modules for DSPy programs, including agentic frameworks, iterative refinement, and aggregation utilities. It enables complex reasoning and programmatic problem-solving.

nodes.label: Information Retrieval Mechanisms
nodes.title: DSPy Retrieval Mechanisms
nodes.description: Offers various retrieval mechanisms for fetching relevant information, including local ColBERTv2, Databricks Vector Search, and Weaviate integrations. It manages retrieved passages for DSPy programs.

nodes.label: DSPy Core Utilities
nodes.title: DSPy Utilities for DSP
nodes.description: Provides essential utilities for DSPy, including text tokenization, answer location, robust configuration management, and efficient loading of background data for retrieval tasks.

edges.label: Leverages for Context
edges.title: Prediction Uses Retrieval
edges.description: Prediction strategies often rely on retrieval modules to fetch relevant context or information to inform their generation process.

edges.label: Uses for Text Processing/Config
edges.title: Retrieval Uses DSP Utilities
edges.description: Retrieval mechanisms may utilize DSP utilities for tasks like text tokenization, configuration management, or efficient data loading.

edges.label: Utilizes for Configuration
edges.title: Prediction Uses DSP Utilities
edges.description: Prediction modules often interact with DSP utilities for global configuration settings, logging, or other helper functions.

groups.label: Prediction Strategies
groups.title: Core Prediction Strategies
groups.description: Encompasses various advanced techniques for generating predictions, including agentic behaviors, iterative refinement, and aggregation, forming the core of DSPy's reasoning capabilities.

groups.label: Retrieval Mechanisms
groups.title: Information Retrieval Components
groups.description: Provides diverse methods for fetching relevant information from external sources, such as vector databases and specialized indexes, to augment language model predictions.

groups.label: Supporting Utilities
groups.title: Foundational DSPy Utilities
groups.description: Offers essential helper functions for text processing, configuration management, and data preparation, supporting both prediction and retrieval operations within DSPy programs.
